new: Beehive @ Bok lists Jenks among the schools it picks up from, Monday to Friday. Its list says only “Jenks”; the other schools on it are all in South Philadelphia, so it is listed here as this Jenks, not J.S. Jenks in Chestnut Hill. Ask Beehive to confirm.

The school’s parent and student handbook, linked from its site, says clubs meet before, during or after school, most starting in October, and names chess, drama, student activity leaders, safety patrol, student government and student council. For clubs after school, parents meet students in the schoolyard and sign them out. They are listed here as the school’s clubs.
Half days end at 11:50 am, according to the school’s site. Ask Beehive whether it covers those afternoons.
The school’s site has an after-school section that points to the City’s program locator, and its community partnerships section is empty.
If you know a program that serves A.S. Jenks and isn’t here, send it in and it goes on this page.

items.listing: n:2026-11-24|Five more schools: A.S. Jenks, Dobson, Shawmont, Fitzpatrick and William Dick

fields.new: Five more schools: A.S. Jenks, Dobson, Shawmont, Fitzpatrick and William Dick

Each has its own page with what runs there, what picks up from it and what’s a short walk away. New to the site are North Light’s KidZone, which picks up from Dobson; Roxborough Church’s Roxy After-School, which picks up from Shawmont; the YMCA’s after care and PYN’s AIM Afterschool inside Fitzpatrick; Launch Philly’s free Creative Kids program and CYBA’s free basketball at William Dick; and Beehive @ Bok’s pickup from A.S. Jenks in South Philadelphia. That makes 86 schools in all.
